steps.title: Report immediately on the cyber crime portal or helpline 1930
steps.detail: Contact the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930 immediately to report financial extortion, cyber harassment, and the illegal loan app. Keep all screenshots ready as proof.

steps.title: File a police complaint or FIR
steps.detail: Approach your local police station to file a formal complaint regarding extortion, criminal intimidation, and defamation under sections 308 and 351 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. Provide your screenshots and app details.

steps.title: (General) Inform your contacts and secure your accounts
steps.detail: Warn your friends, family, and colleagues that your photos have been morphed by a fraudulent loan app and advise them to block the numbers sending these messages. Change your social media privacy settings immediately.
steps.where: Phone contacts and social media platforms

steps.title: Seek free legal aid and guidance
steps.detail: If you need professional guidance or assistance with legal filings, contact the District Legal Services Authority or call the NALSA toll-free helpline for free legal aid.

draft_document.text:
To,
The Officer In Charge,
Cyber Crime Cell / Local Police Station,
[YOUR CITY/DISTRICT]

SUBJECT: COMPLAINT AGAINST ILLEGAL LOAN APP FOR EXTORTION, CRIMINAL INTIMIDATION, AND DEFAMATION

Respected Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally report severe harassment, extortion, and criminal intimidation being conducted against me by an illegal loan application operating under the name [LOAN APP NAME].

1. I took a small loan of Rs 5000 through the said app. 
2. Starting on or around [DATE], the representatives of the app began demanding an exorbitant amount of Rs 30000.
3. Upon my inability to pay this inflated demand, the app started sending morphed, obscene, and defamatory photos of me to my personal contacts.
4. They are continuously sending threatening messages and making extortion demands, causing severe mental agony and harming my reputation.

I have attached screenshots of the threat messages, details of the app, and phone numbers used by the perpetrators as evidence.

I request you to kindly register an FIR under relevant provisions including Sections 308 and 351 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, investigate this matter, freeze their accounts, and take strict legal action against the culprits to stop this harassment.

Thanking you,

[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR PHONE NUMBER]
[YOUR ADDRESS]
Date: [DATE]

reasons: There are threats, blackmail or violence involved. Report it to the police now, keep all messages, and involve a lawyer. The steps below still apply.
